scenes.setting: Backlund at last: Klein steps off the train into the Land of Hope's yellow haze, shakes a pickpocket at the station exit, and plans his lodging over a newspaper and map
scenes.text_anchor: He took a firm step onto the ground of the Loen Kingdom's capital, Backlund.

scenes.setting: Backlund Metro entrance: Klein marvels at a steam-age metro, buys a second-class ticket from the golden-haired cashier, and heads down to the platform
scenes.text_anchor: That was the Backlund Metro's entrance.

scenes.setting: Metro carriage bound for Cherwood Borough: a thin boy apologizes his way toward third class with black-coated men rushing in after him
scenes.text_anchor: He didn't wait long before he heard the chugging sound of the train and the thunderous steam whistle.

scenes.setting: Second-class metro carriage: highlander toughs storm in demanding the boy's whereabouts; the conductor points them to third class
scenes.text_anchor: "Did you see a teenage boy? He's wearing an old coat!"

scenes.setting: As the metro pulls out, the red-eyed boy calmly re-enters from first class — Klein scans him with Spirit Vision, impressed by his maturity
scenes.text_anchor: The teenage boy walked slowly into the carriage wearing his old coat and round top hat

scenes.setting: Cherwood Borough: a rented carriage to Minsk Street; the doorbell of Unit 17 pops out a cuckooing mechanical bird
scenes.text_anchor: He took a rented carriage for nearly ten minutes before finding Minsk Street.

scenes.setting: Unit 17 foyer: the young maidservant warily admits the caller about the Stelyn Sammer rental listing and takes his coat and cane
scenes.text_anchor: A young maidservant dressed in white and black looked warily at Klein

scenes.setting: The Sammers' sitting room on Minsk Street: tea offered, the landlady sizing up her prospective tenant, and the question he has been preparing for all the way from Tingen -- how might I address you?
scenes.text_anchor: “How might I address you?”

scenes.setting: He gives the name he had long thought of -- Sherlock Moriarty -- and from this line on that is who he is: the pipes in the kitchen, the machinery-enthusiast husband, the rent, and a new life in Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: “Sherlock Moriarty. You can call me Sherlock.”

scenes.setting: The master of the house returns: introductions with Luke Sammer, a dinner invitation politely declined
scenes.text_anchor: At that moment, the door suddenly opened. A stout man walked in

scenes.setting: Unit 15: Julianne shows the empty terrace house — rent part of it out if you like, but not to workers
scenes.text_anchor: The layout was very similar to the unit next door.

scenes.setting: Alone in the bare living room: weighing jobs that leave freedom for revenge and advancement — author, reporter... private detective it is
scenes.text_anchor: He sat in an empty living room and suddenly felt lonely.

scenes.setting: First Backlund morning: the detective advertisement placed in the Backlund Bulletin, ritual materials bought across half the borough, Holy Night Powder ground at 15 Minsk Street
scenes.text_anchor: Klein started his first morning in Backlund under cold and humid weather conditions

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: The Fool takes his high-back chair and touches the crimson star of The Sun — one thing in the new life that hasn't changed
scenes.text_anchor: Klein took four steps counterclockwise and arrived above the gray fog.

scenes.setting: A half-collapsed tower outside the City of Silver: Derrick by the bonfire among his patrol squad feels the summons and feigns sleep (The Fool's call: vision only)
scenes.text_anchor: Nine members of a patrol squad were gathered around a blazing bonfire

scenes.setting: Empress Borough bedroom: Audrey waits eagerly for the summons — two weeks on, the Rainbow Salamander gland and Sequence 8 beckon
scenes.text_anchor: Using the excuse that she was tired, Audrey returned to her bedroom.

scenes.setting: The captain's cabin of an ancient sailboat: Alger memorizes copied diary pages, haunted by Qilangos's rotting face as the crimson tide takes him
scenes.text_anchor: Alger Wilson locked the door to the captain's cabin

scenes.setting: Tarot Club, palace above the gray fog: The Hanged Man tenders nineteen diary pages as payment for Qilangos — six arrive now, equivalent exchange
scenes.text_anchor: Having activated his Spirit Vision, Klein examined Justice, The Hanged Man, and The Sun

scenes.setting: Diary-reading interlude: 16th December — Roselle records contacting the pathetic fellow trapped in the storm, 'Mr. Door', and his offer of three wishes for a way back into the real world (reading continues into ch217)
scenes.text_anchor: Klein looked down and read the first page

scenes.setting: Diary-reading interlude, continued from ch216: Mr. Door's history of the War of the Four Emperors and the two Laws of Beyonder Characteristics; then Roselle's Savant-pathway complaints and the eve of the Intis rebellion — 'Consul Roselle Gustav. I like that name.'
scenes.text_anchor: Mr. Door… This naming style is very similar to mine…

scenes.setting: Diary-reading interlude, final pages: Edwards counsels against courting the Eternal Blazing Sun, Grimm lies dead in the Sea of Fog, and Zaratul of the Secret Order pays Roselle a sudden incognito visit on the eve of the coup
scenes.text_anchor: "June 3rd. After discussing with Edwards and the others

scenes.setting: Tarot Club, reading over: The Fool dispenses free general knowledge — the Laws of Beyonder Characteristics Indestructibility and Similar-Sequence Conservation — and Audrey glimpses how dark the mystical world runs; explanations, of course, cost extra
scenes.text_anchor: Putting down the six diary pages, Klein tapped his right index finger on the edge of the long bronze table

scenes.setting: Tarot Club, same gathering: The Fool sells the Similar-Sequence exchange explanation for Secret Order intelligence; Audrey books a Spectator-pathway question, Alger has the Rainbow Salamander gland, and Klein proposes a cooperative delivery experiment
scenes.text_anchor: “Mr. Fool, what kind of payment do you want?”

scenes.setting: Tarot Club, same gathering: The Fool teaches the sacrifice-and-bestowment ritual (altar, Pupil-less Eye symbol, prayer in ancient Hermes) so Alger can deliver the Rainbow Salamander gland to Audrey; Audrey proposes two Backlund lady candidates for the Club; gathering ends with Klein waiting in the fog for the sacrifice
scenes.text_anchor: “Attempt?” Justice was instantly thrilled

chapters_detail.title: The Tarot Club at a Higher Level

scenes.setting: Captain cabin of the Blue Avenger on the Sonia Sea: Alger performs the first sacrificial ritual — the illusory door opens onto the fog palace, the Rainbow Salamander gland is taken, and The Fool answers "You did well"
scenes.text_anchor: Alger Wilson stood in the captain cabin

scenes.setting: Majestic palace above the gray fog: Klein toys with the color-shifting pituitary gland, savoring the sacrifice system's success
scenes.text_anchor: Klein was playing with the pituitary gland of the Rainbow Salamander

scenes.setting: Audrey's bedroom: The Fool appears in the fog vision, walks her through the bestowment ritual — the gland arrives on her altar and she drinks the Telepathist potion, advancing on the spot
scenes.text_anchor: Audrey was no longer able to sit quietly on the edge of the bed

scenes.setting: Audrey lets the suspicious golden retriever back in and consults her on how to secretly bait Xio and Fors with Mr. Fool's name
scenes.text_anchor: she smiled and walked briskly to the door, letting in the golden retriever

scenes.setting: Backlund preparations: disguise shopping, renting a bolt-hole in squalid East Borough, two days of ritual practice — until Thursday morning the doorbell finally rings
scenes.text_anchor: He spent a pound to buy a pair of gold-rimmed glasses

scenes.setting: 15 Minsk Street, Thursday morning: Detective Moriarty's first clients — old Madam Doris and her formally dressed grandson — hire him for 5 soli to find Brody the missing black cat
scenes.text_anchor: A rope was being tugged, causing the doorbell and the sound it made to constantly tinkle

scenes.setting: 58 Minsk Street: a covert cane divination points at the old cupboard — Brody darts out, and "Inference, my good man" seals the detective's first solved case
scenes.text_anchor: “Jurgen, Jurgen Cooper, a senior solicitor,” the young man replied.

scenes.setting: Back at 15 Minsk Street: the red-eyed boy from the metro chase — Ian — hires Moriarty over the disappearance of his former detective, Mr. Zreal Viktor Lee
scenes.text_anchor: “You can call me Ian,” the teenage boy surveyed his surroundings

scenes.setting: 15 Minsk Street guest area: contract signed — five pounds advance plus three future favors — and the obsessively neat Ian hands over nearly all his savings for the Zreal investigation
scenes.text_anchor: “So you suspect that the Zreal whom the detectives saw was someone in disguise?”

scenes.setting: Alone after Ian leaves: a coin-toss divination on Beyonder involvement in the case slips through Klein's fingers — the boy has withheld too much for even a vague answer
scenes.text_anchor: Watching the boy who was more mature than his age leave

scenes.setting: 138 Rose Street in the small hours: disguised as a bearded workman, Klein pendulum-checks the danger, slips into Zreal's dark house, Slumber-Charms the three men lying in ambush, and settles on the sofa with Zreal's hairs for a dream divination
scenes.text_anchor: That night, in the wee hours of the morning, at 138 Rose Street

scenes.setting: Zreal's crimson-lit bedroom (visions only: Zreal's rat-gnawed corpse in the dream divination; Meursault in the sleeper's memory): the soul interrogation names the Zmanger gang executioner Meursault as the one waiting for Ian, then a nimble latch-trick exit out the oriel window
scenes.text_anchor: The dim room was covered in a thin veil of crimson moonlight

scenes.setting: Midnight walk into East Borough: waves of numbed poor shuffle through the dark, driven off the streets and parks by an officer bellowing the Poor Law
scenes.text_anchor: Klein quickly left the vicinity, as well as Rose Street

scenes.setting: Dowsing-rod divination leads to an East Borough sewer: Zreal's chewed corpse among the rats; the spirit channeling fails — a Beyonder has dealt with Zreal's spirit — so Klein ends his involvement and will have Ian call the police
scenes.text_anchor: After repeated divinations, Klein walked for a long time

scenes.setting: Out of the sewers ahead of approaching footsteps, disguise shed in East Borough, a counter-surveillance detour home to Cherwood Borough — sleep until the dawn doorbell
scenes.text_anchor: Klein backed up from the fork in the path, without touching Zreal's corpse.

scenes.setting: 15 Minsk Street doorstep: Klein tells Ian he has found Zreal's corpse; Ian asks to see the body and agrees to keep the detective out of the police report
scenes.text_anchor: “Good morning, Detective Moriarty,” Ian greeted him

scenes.setting: East Borough sewer: Ian vomits at the mutilated corpse (more of it missing than last night), confirms it is Zreal, and pays the first of three favors — the Bravehearts Bar and the name Kaspars Kalinin for an unlicensed gun
scenes.text_anchor: Both of them took the public carriage to the East Borough.

scenes.setting: Klein doubles back and watches from a corner as Ian warily re-enters the sewer — the matter goes deeper than it seems
scenes.text_anchor: Klein suddenly turned around and retraced his steps

scenes.setting: Viscount Glaint's study, Empress Borough, at tea time: Audrey pays Xio and Fors 800 pounds, then invisibly steers them to borrow the planted books that hide Mr. Fool's name
scenes.text_anchor: At tea time, Viscount Glaint was in his home situated in Empress Borough.

scenes.setting: Evening by the fireplace: Xio finds the interlayer paper in the borrowed book — Roselle's symbols on one side and The Fool's honorific name in ancient Hermes on the other
scenes.text_anchor: Xio was curled up on the sofa in front of the fireplace

scenes.setting: 15 Minsk Street by the charcoal fire: Klein circles an intriguing 'new type of transportation vehicle' investment ad — then an illusory prayer echoes in his ears
scenes.text_anchor: A satiated Klein sat in a reclining chair in the living room

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: a petite woman in a knight's trainee uniform reading the paper — Justice's candidate): Klein touches the prayer's light ripples but withholds any response, planning a deeper test at night
scenes.text_anchor: Taking four steps counterclockwise, he entered the world above the gray fog.

scenes.setting: Xio's living room: horror sets in — she has silently recited the full honorific name of a hidden existence in unprotected ancient Hermes
scenes.text_anchor: Xio, who had just finished chanting the ancient Hermes sentence, froze

scenes.setting: Bathroom ambush on window-climbing Fors, then a nervous joint study of the yellowed paper and the other borrowed books — no second paper found; they agree to wait for morning
scenes.text_anchor: she spotted a long, slightly curly brown hair in the mirror

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog at midnight: Klein pulls the sleeping Xio in as a blurry figure at the bronze table's edge, severs the link at once, and a new crimson star of stable connection is born
scenes.text_anchor: Klein instinctively woke up, lifted his blanket, got off the bed

scenes.setting: Xio jolts awake beside the sleeping Fors, resolving to seek an exorcist at tomorrow's Beyonder gathering
scenes.text_anchor: Xio sat up in her sleep.

scenes.setting: Foggy-morning breakfast experiments at 15 Minsk Street, newspaper plans to inspect Mr. Leppard's new transportation vehicle in St. George Borough
scenes.text_anchor: Sitting at his own dining table on a foggy morning

scenes.setting: Hammer-loud knocks: the Zmanger executioner Meursault offers 10, 30, then 50 pounds for Ian Wright — the detective refuses on principle and gets a cold, fierce stare
scenes.text_anchor: It was the highlander man who had chased Ian at the steam metro.

scenes.setting: Unit 9, Sird Street, St. George Borough: inventor Leppard demos his pedal-carriage built from Roselle's manuscripts; Klein steers him to the bicycle and buys 35% of the idea for 100 pounds
scenes.text_anchor: “I'm Leppard. Come in, please.”

scenes.setting: Home again in the drizzle: washing his hands, a Clown premonition floods in — the bathroom mirror shows a pair of eyes beside his lowered head
scenes.text_anchor: As the water echoed, Klein bent down to wash his hands.

scenes.setting: 15 Minsk Street ambush (visions only: the Intis 'Mr. Ambassador' ordering the hunt for Ian Wright in the dream divinations): a blow-dart and brutal melee wreck the house until a flung contract template pierces Meursault's throat; the corpse yields answers and a dark-red Beyonder characteristic
scenes.text_anchor: A small black-feathered arrow stabbed into the wash basin.

scenes.setting: Alone with Meursault's corpse: pendulum divination picks the lesser of two evils — report it; the scene is dressed (dagger in the wound), every mystical item stashed above the gray fog, and the clock walked past the one-hour mediumship window
scenes.text_anchor: Meursault's body lay there, his eyes wide open

scenes.setting: Rain-lit Minsk Street and the wrecked house: Klein flags down the patrol, then feeds the sergeant a tuned self-defense account naming Meursault, the Zmanger gang and 'Mr. Ambassador' — faith declared: God of Steam and Machinery, to dodge the Nighthawks
scenes.text_anchor: “Officers! A criminal attacked me! ” Klein shouted with great skill.

scenes.setting: Mr. A's hooded gathering in an unremarkable Empress Borough house: the Sheriff formula still chalked at 450 pounds — Xio finally has the money
scenes.text_anchor: Xio and Fors took a seat at random and examined the writing on the blackboard.

scenes.setting: First-floor study, both parties robed and hooded: cash for the Sheriff potion formula — main ingredients a pair of Terror Demon Worm's eyes and a Silver War Bear's right palm
scenes.text_anchor: “This is the formula to the Sheriff potion. Where's my money?”

scenes.setting: Back beside Fors, Xio posts a 30-pound exorcism request on the blackboard against the evil spirit she fears is haunting her
scenes.text_anchor: Back in the living room, she sat beside Fors.

scenes.setting: A white-masked believer of the Eternal Blazing Sun performs the purification — warm tidal light engulfs Xio and Fors like a hot spring
scenes.text_anchor: There was a man wearing a white mask inside.

scenes.setting: Rice Police Station bench among thieves and drunkards: an unexplained warmth touches Klein's marked hand (the Sun purification, harmlessly diverted) before the sergeant summons him to interrogation
scenes.text_anchor: Klein was sitting on a low bench with a group of thieves and drunkards.

scenes.setting: Interrogation room: a Sequence 7 Interrogator of the Arbiter pathway whips Klein's mind — he identifies the ambassador's photo, keeps his story straight, and walks out drained to news that Lawyer Jurgen has come to bail him
scenes.text_anchor: “I ask, you answer.”

scenes.setting: Rice Police Station office and the carriage home: Jurgen bails Klein out pro bono (ten pounds, reclaimable in a week), and gets hired to draft the bicycle investment contract — two pounds, ready Monday
scenes.text_anchor: Klein met Jurgen Cooper in an office at the Rice Police Station.

scenes.setting: Home to the wrecked living room — then the Sammers' frightened maid Julianne rings: the neighbors want a word
scenes.text_anchor: saw Julianne, the maid from next door in a black-and-white skirt

scenes.setting: The Sammers' living room: gracious landlords over black tea — talk of the 'thief', a private detective's earnings, and what a truly decent Backlund life costs (seven pounds a week, at least)
scenes.text_anchor: Luke Sammer and his wife, Stelyn Sammer were sitting on a sofa in the living room.

scenes.setting: Cleaning up alone, wary of military surveillance: tomorrow night, the Bravehearts Bar for a gun — and perhaps a Beyonder bodyguard
scenes.text_anchor: After returning home, Klein began laboring.

scenes.setting: After the purification, blessed water in a metal bottle — then a note reaches 'Miss Arbiter': the formula seller wants a chat in the study
scenes.text_anchor: After the purification ceremony ended, the man in the white mask said

scenes.setting: Back in Mr. A's living room: rattled by the anonymous note, Xio takes Fors's advice — go, Mr. A is watching — and follows the attendant to the study
scenes.text_anchor: Who? How did that person know that I purchased the Sheriff recipe?

scenes.setting: The study: a golden-masked man in a tuxedo — the true seller of the Sheriff formula — recruits 'Miss Arbiter' for paid missions, dangling the Terror Demon Worm eyes and Silver War Bear palm she cannot yet afford
scenes.text_anchor: The man wore a golden mask that revealed his eyes, nostrils, mouth, and cheeks

scenes.setting: Sunday of repairs: 6 pounds 9 soli to restore the living room — though Meursault's Beyonder characteristic is worth 300, if only Klein had a circle to sell it in
scenes.text_anchor: Klein busied himself with buying chairs and tea sets

scenes.setting: Bravehearts Bar, Iron Gate Street: rat-baiting and boxing stages, a five-pence Southville beer, and a quiet question — where is Kaspars Kalinin? Billiard room 3
scenes.text_anchor: He saw Bravehearts Bar after taking a few steps.

scenes.setting: Billiard room 3: 'Old Geezer introduced me' — the scarred, brandy-nosed Kaspars sells a custom silver revolver with fifty rounds and agrees to ask around for a beyond-human bodyguard
scenes.text_anchor: Kaspars Kalinin hobbled over and asked, “What do you want?”

scenes.setting: The card room behind the kitchen: a Texas-poker table where Spirit Vision reveals every player but one is a black-aura zombie — and the pale man in the black vest comes over with deep malice in his eyes
scenes.text_anchor: It was a card room where more than ten people were playing Texas poker.

chapters_detail.title: A Man Cannot Be Judged By His Looks

scenes.setting: The card room and corridor of the Bravehearts Bar: pale Maric — who plays poker with a table of zombies — hears 'I offended a big shot backed by a country', declares the mission priceless and throws Klein out; Kaspars will keep asking around
scenes.text_anchor: a living person was playing cards with more than ten corpses

scenes.setting: Curtained bedroom on Minsk Street (visions only: Ian asleep under his satchel in a cramped doss room): the dream divination locates nothing useful, so Klein stages a written alibi — 'I don't know Ian Wright's whereabouts'
scenes.text_anchor: After washing up, Klein didn't waste any charcoal.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: golden replay of Xio's exorcism by the white-masked Sun believer and her study meeting with the golden-masked man): the new crimson star's sun-gold core explains the warm current — the purification unknowingly kept Xio's channel open
scenes.text_anchor: he realized that the core position of the newly added crimson star had been dyed with a sun-like gold

chapters_detail.title: The Night of the Full Moon

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: Ian asleep, Ian pulling a tooth from Zreal's corpse, Ian at a telegraph office; the Intis ambassador handing Meursault the Hunter potion): the dream divinations reveal an organization behind Zreal and Ian, and confirm the ambassador's Intis pedigree
scenes.text_anchor: It was the same dream divination, but this time Klein saw more.

scenes.setting: Back in the bedroom: the map narrows the vision to the Bacardi Street telegraph office at the East Borough–Backlund Bridge junction; Klein leaves his 'I don't know where Ian is' note face-up as deliberate bait and goes to sleep under the full crimson moon
scenes.text_anchor: He rummaged through the map of Backlund that he had bought

scenes.setting: A house at Hillston Borough: Fors writhes under the full-moon murmurs, tearing out hair — the affliction she lied to Xio about is getting worse every month, and no Trickmaster formula is anywhere to be found
scenes.text_anchor: Fors, who didn't sleep with Xio, sat up suddenly and put her hands to her head.

scenes.setting: Monday morning: the bait note has rotated 180 degrees behind sealed windows — yet divination insists no one entered last night. Either the divination was disrupted, or the visitor was not human
scenes.text_anchor: It had flipped over and changed orientation after a night's sleep!

scenes.setting: Monday morning: Klein leaves the Ian-information bait note in place for both the ambassador's people and the military watchers, and heads out into the choking smog for a breakfast appointment
scenes.text_anchor: He pretended that nothing had happened and turned the page so that it faced him.

scenes.setting: 58 Minsk Street: Brody the cat opens the door itself; Jurgen delivers the finished investment contract for two pounds, and Mrs. Doris's bean turnip soup turns out surprisingly delicious
scenes.text_anchor: Brody the black cat walked straight to the door.

scenes.setting: Sird Street: the formal agreement signed and Leppard's first fifty pounds paid — 21 pounds 8 soli left in Klein's pocket
scenes.text_anchor: he made a formal agreement and paid Leppard the first fifty pound

scenes.setting: Cherwood public library: a year of Tussock Times confirms the dream-divination face — Intis ambassador Bakerland Jean Madan
scenes.text_anchor: he returned to Cherwood Borough and went to the public library

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: the iron-black threadworm that flipped the bait note, on Ambassador Bakerland's orders): pre-gathering divinations, then Justice, The Hanged Man and The Sun are pulled in on the stroke of three
scenes.text_anchor: He first divined if the military's special department had relaxed their surveillance

scenes.setting: Tarot Club: the newly advanced 'Miss Telepathist' is welcomed; Alger hands over this week's six diary pages and reports that the Secret Order has some connection with the Intis Republic
scenes.text_anchor: “Good afternoon, Mr. Fool~ Good afternoon, Mr. Hanged Man! Good afternoon, Mr. Sun!”

scenes.setting: Tarot Club, same gathering: The Fool issues his first official mission — assassinate Intis ambassador Bakerland Jean Madan 'for another adorer'; Alger supplies the ambassador's dark dossier, and both Justice and The Hanged Man accept
scenes.text_anchor: “The task he wants to be completed is the assassination of the Intis Republic ambassador

scenes.setting: Diary-reading interlude at the gathering: Zaratul names himself a Sequence 2 Miracle Invoker and points to Monster as the true fate pathway; Matilda's pregnancy reveals the laws of Beyonder-characteristic inheritance; pirate Savigny Solomon is made Count of the Court, his son Nast foretold to dominate the Five Seas
scenes.text_anchor: “29th October. The leader of the Secret Order, Zaratul, visited me once again.

scenes.setting: Reading over, free trading opens: Audrey asks The Sun for dragon lore, and Derrick names his price — the Sequence 8 Bard potion formula
scenes.text_anchor: “You are free to trade or communicate now.”

scenes.setting: Tarot Club, closing stretch: The Fool trades the Light Suppliant formula to The Sun for a future favor from Justice; Derrick recounts the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt and Dragon of Nightmare Alzuhod (whose coincidence-weaving unnervingly resembles Sealed Artifact 0-08); gathering adjourned
scenes.text_anchor: “Miss Justice, perhaps I can provide the Light Suppliant formula for you.”

scenes.setting: Count Hall's villa, Empress Borough: maid Annie brings a telegram — brother Alfred has found two Rainbow Salamanders for the pituitary gland Audrey no longer needs; Susie wags, stupefied
scenes.text_anchor: “Miss, a telegram for you came from the Southern Continent.”

scenes.setting: Count Hall's villa: the salamanders will go to Susie's potion; weighed down by her debts to Mr. Fool, Audrey accepts Countess Jaria's ball invitation — Ambassador Bakerland will be there to observe
scenes.text_anchor: Well, I don't need it anymore, but I can give it to Susie

scenes.setting: Bayam, City of Generosity, Rorsted Archipelago: Alger dons a white mask and coded knocks to slip into a safehouse meeting
scenes.text_anchor: Alger Wilson changed into attire that was considered gaudy in the Intis Republic

scenes.setting: 15 Minsk Street: Klein reasons the threadworm Beyonder is Seer-pathway — Secret Order and Intis intertwined; he re-equips everything from above the fog and heads out for the Bravehearts Bar
scenes.text_anchor: At 15 Minsk Street, Klein drew the curtains open and sat down at his desk.

scenes.setting: Two pounds buys an introduction: Kaspars leads Klein from the bar's kitchen to a darkened house, hands him a half-face iron mask, and knocks the coded rhythm
scenes.text_anchor: Klein found Kaspars in a card room, playing Fighting Evil

scenes.setting: A candle-lit activity room of hooded, iron-masked Beyonders: Klein takes a corner chair as a fat-faced apothecary complains about clever beasts eating his sewer-grown herbs
scenes.text_anchor: There were about ten people sitting on the sofas and chairs around the coffee table.

scenes.setting: The iron-mask gathering: the fat-faced apothecary hires a sewer-beast cleaner; old Eye of Wisdom pays 400 pounds for Meursault's crimson 'jelly'; no one dares bodyguard against a Sequence 6 — so Black Snake tempts Klein with an ominous item that lets one hear the voice of a great being. Deal.
scenes.text_anchor: “I repeat, I need someone to clean up the newly appeared beast in the sewers.

scenes.setting: The deal closes by candlelight: 400 pounds to Black Snake, the rotting black ear to Klein — with the apothecary's gallows-humor warnings — then the gathering disperses one by one, three minutes apart
scenes.text_anchor: He took out a small wooden box, bent down, and placed it on the ground.

scenes.setting: Back through the Bravehearts kitchen: Kaspars is relieved to see him alive, promises word of future gatherings — and Klein steers well clear of Maric's card room
scenes.text_anchor: “I'm delighted that you could come back.”

scenes.setting: In the card room, Maric's four Kings lose to a zombie's four Sixes — he staggers out coughing dark blue, orders the room sealed till dawn, and drinks alone
scenes.text_anchor: Inside the card room, Maric had gone all-in and confidently flipped open his cards.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: a Listener swelling and blackening in the divination): the black ear channels the True Creator's foul voice — tentacles burst from Klein's veins, the fog holds, and the stripped madness fuses into a sealed charm he names Language of Foulness
scenes.text_anchor: he started to summon himself. He responded to himself and brought the wooden box containing the black ear

scenes.setting: Tuesday breakfast with the Tussock Times: a 2 a.m. gunfight at Red Brick Alley near Bacardi Street — both sides acted on Klein's planted note within a day; then the doorbell rings
scenes.text_anchor: Early Tuesday morning, Klein woke up naturally

scenes.setting: Stelyn Sammer brings her veiled friend Mary Gale, a Coim shareholder: tail her husband and photograph his mistress — ten pounds with material evidence, camera provided
scenes.text_anchor: “This is Mrs. Mary Gale, a shareholder of Coim Company.”

scenes.setting: Count Wolf's ball: Audrey endures the lecherous Ambassador Bakerland's jokes, then harvests intel from MI9's Kance Leerhsen — Sequence 6 Conspiracist, a Sequence 5 assistant in the shadows, soon to be replaced — and asks Glaint to arrange a meeting with Xio and Fors
scenes.text_anchor: Audrey was carrying a glass of pale gold champagne

scenes.setting: Wednesday stakeout opposite the Coim Company: a bench outside Gardeley's, a Cyndi Desi pie, iced tea, and Mary Gale's dossier on her husband's suspicious Wednesdays
scenes.text_anchor: Klein was sitting on a wooden bench outside the Gardeley department store

scenes.setting: The bump-and-plant: a spare button slipped into Doragu Gale's coat pocket, then dowsing-rod pursuit by carriage to a garden-backed house in Hillston Borough
scenes.text_anchor: Doragu Gale… He silently recited his target's name

scenes.setting: The Quelaag Club's marble doorstep: members only, entry by double recommendation — Klein withdraws to Plan B
scenes.text_anchor: “This is the Quelaag Club. Only our members and up to one of their guests can enter.”

scenes.setting: A short-stay hotel room, then above the gray fog (visions only: Doragu Gale romping with his young blonde mistress): adultery confirmed but unphotographable — and a stray divination reveals the threadworm's controller is Seer-pathway, hinting the fog itself is tied to the Seer path
scenes.text_anchor: This time, he didn't use the dowsing method, but a dream divination!

scenes.setting: Viscount Glaint's study, the Viscount guarding his own door: Audrey delegates the mission — assassinate Intis ambassador Bakerland Jean Madan
scenes.text_anchor: “Assassinate the Intis ambassador to the Loen Kingdom, Bakerland Jean Madan.”

scenes.setting: Glaint's study: Audrey clarifies the job — find a Beyonder who CAN kill Bakerland; 4000 pounds for the deed, 500 for the brokering, 200 even on failure
scenes.text_anchor: “What?” Fors touched her earlobes, wondering if she had heard wrongly.

scenes.setting: Mr. A's house at three o'clock: the hooded host accepts the assassination — for a High-Sequence formula (Unshadowed, Cataclysmic Interrer, Prophet or Manipulator) or 10,000 gold pounds
scenes.text_anchor: “Assassinate the Intis ambassador to the Loen Kingdom, Bakerland Jean Madan.”

scenes.setting: Evening handoff: Mr. A's terms passed to the familiar large golden retriever at a predetermined spot
scenes.text_anchor: the two of them met the familiar large golden retriever at a predetermined location

scenes.setting: Audrey, relieved it is only 10,000 pounds, plans a discreet 8000-pound loan and writes back: option two — 2000 in advance, 8000 on completion
scenes.text_anchor: When Audrey finished reading the note

scenes.setting: Tea-time report at 15 Minsk Street: the mistress is Erica Taylor of 126 New Year's Street; Mary will sponsor 'famous detective' Moriarty into the Quelaag Club to get the material evidence
scenes.text_anchor: Klein saw Mary Gale again at tea time.

scenes.setting: Bravehearts Bar after dinner: a zombie-less Maric relays that a friend — stronger than him, short on money — will bodyguard Klein for three days at 1000 pounds
scenes.text_anchor: “Does that job of yours still stand?”

scenes.setting: Home again, feigning normalcy for the watchers: an illusory woman's prayer reaches Klein as he waits out the evening until ten
scenes.text_anchor: Back home at 15 Minsk Street, Klein was in no hurry

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: Justice reports Mr. A's terms; Klein deduces Mr. A is an Aurora Order Oracle (never trade formulas with lunatics), divines that Maric's friend is low-risk and Mr. A will genuinely threaten Bakerland, then approves the plan and asks 1000 pounds 'for his adorer'
scenes.text_anchor: Dressed in a white silk nightgown, Miss Justice appeared in front of him.

scenes.setting: Audrey with her music score under the faint red moon: relief — the debt to Mr. Fool is nearly cleared, even if it means months of tight finances
scenes.text_anchor: Audrey was holding a music score and humming a melody.

scenes.setting: Thursday: the 1000 pounds lands in the anonymous account; Mary Gale presents Klein's two Quelaag Club sponsors — surgeon Aaron Ceres and the affable ex-noble equestrian teacher Talim Dumont
scenes.text_anchor: One was a well-known surgeon, Aaron Ceres, and the other was the aristocratic equestrian teacher, Talim Dumont.

scenes.setting: Quelaag Club induction: member #192, Frost-constellation badge, 50-pound entry on Mary Gale's account, and a tour of the buffet, lounges, tennis courts and underground shooting ranges
scenes.text_anchor: “Mr. Moriarty, welcome to the Quelaag Club.”

scenes.setting: An Intis-style lounge: mid-scheming about the camera flash problem, a strange omen grips Klein — the air goes still as the calm before a storm, though divination denies any coming attack
scenes.text_anchor: At that moment, his heart suddenly palpitated as he tensed up.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: Ian beneath gas lamps and the blurry crimson moon): the coin confirms grave danger in the next few days — vague, unshortenable, its trigger somehow reaching him through no ability he owns
scenes.text_anchor: “I will be in grave danger in the next few days.”

scenes.setting: Bank withdrawal, then the Bravehearts card room: 100 pounds down and 300 per day — Maric nods to empty air and announces 'she has agreed'; the hidden protection begins now
scenes.text_anchor: “I'll pay an advance of 100 pounds.

scenes.setting: The bathroom mirror at 15 Minsk Street: Klein's reflection dissolves into a pale, golden-haired woman in a black regal dress who curtsies — the 1000-pound bodyguard introducing herself
scenes.text_anchor: he saw himself phasing away in the mirror before transforming into a woman wearing a black regal dress

scenes.setting: After the mirror apparition: Spirit Vision finds nothing, Azik's copper whistle stays cold — whatever she is, she is no ordinary ghost
scenes.text_anchor: Did I just hire a female ghost as my bodyguard?

scenes.setting: The doorbell under the crimson moon — exactly the dream-divination image: Ian, fresh out of MI9, comes to apologize for dragging the detective into it all
scenes.text_anchor: “Detective Moriarty,” Ian took off his brown top hat

scenes.setting: The whole story in the living room, the ghostly bodyguard listening from an illusory chair: Zreal was a Feysac spy, the prize is Turani von Helmosuin's manuscript, and a traitor beside Zreal's superior doomed them — while Klein privately audits the one small mistake (no disguise) that cost him 10,000 pounds
scenes.text_anchor: “In fact, Detective Zreal is a spy for the Feysac Empire.

scenes.setting: Home, waiting for the storm: Klein decides to stay and welcome his attackers; the bodyguard's face surfaces on the gas lamp's glass to accept his carefully worded 'I'm also a Beyonder' confession
scenes.text_anchor: he suddenly saw a face appear on the glass cover of the gas lamp

scenes.setting: The doorbell again: Sergeant Faxine waits impatiently under the gas lamps — bail news, a warning, or something else?
scenes.text_anchor: a sergeant in a black-and-white checkered uniform with three chevrons on his epaulets was impatiently waiting

scenes.setting: The Intis embassy ball: while Rosago races MI9 for the manuscript, Bakerland lures 'timber merchant's daughter' Eileen to his room — her nails sprout black spider legs, and his gut-punch turns seduction into interrogation
scenes.text_anchor: A ball was being held.

scenes.setting: The assassination in the embassy bedroom: a Shepherd of the Aurora Order bursts from inside Eileen's body, twists Bakerland's own no-disturb order into an isolation, saps him with a Demoness of Affliction's pneumonia, and — as Saint Tenebrous's recorded dark knight — cuts the Pyromaniac ambassador in two
scenes.text_anchor: “Rose Bishop!” As a veteran intelligence officer, Bakerland immediately identified

scenes.setting: Back at 15 Minsk Street: the coin says the visitor is no danger — Sergeant Faxine has only come with a warning from the higher-ups: be careful of strangers tonight and tomorrow
scenes.text_anchor: Sergeant Faxine took off his hat and said with a serious expression

scenes.setting: The sergeant's face squirms into Rosago, the Seer-pathway assistant: puppet-like control seizes Klein and the ghostly bodyguard both — until the Language of Foulness charm floods the room with the True Creator's voice and five point-blank rounds end Rosago; Slumber Charms put the screaming bodyguard mercifully under
scenes.text_anchor: “By the way, my name is Rosago.”

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog with Rosago's remnant spirituality in tow: Klein discovers he can now channel spirits directly like a true medium, and opens with the question that matters — 'The potion formulas for the Seer pathway'
scenes.text_anchor: he saw the distinct remnants of Rosago's spirituality

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: Rosago's memories — his mentor's warnings against divination-reliance and the formulas): Klein harvests Magician (Sequence 7), Faceless (Sequence 6) and most of Nimblewright Master (Sequence 5, mermaid-song ritual) before his spirituality runs dry and the fog ejects him
scenes.text_anchor: “Sequence 7. Magician:

scenes.setting: The bodyguard wakes, thinner and more translucent: she buys Klein's panicked-charms story ('You'd better find a psychiatrist'), and they split the spoils — she takes the Notary document, he pockets Rosago's evil-god-tainted pupil-less eye, 'worthless' though it is
scenes.text_anchor: Miss Bodyguard in her black Gothic regal dress had woken up and was floating in the air

scenes.setting: Cleanup: touching the tainted black eye shows the world laced with black threads; Miss Bodyguard sinks into Rosago's headless corpse, regrows a cracked-glass head, scours the scene spotless, and walks the body out into the night
scenes.text_anchor: She slowly sank in and fused with the corpse!

scenes.setting: Alone on the sofa, adrenaline draining: a coin toss — 'Bakerland is already dead' — lands heads. Positive. The whole affair is finally over
scenes.text_anchor: Klein fished out a coin and, with recited with a suppressed tone, “Bakerland is already dead.”

scenes.setting: The embassy: two military officials read the corpse — disease, isolation, flesh-blood magic, an obliterating blow — and reach the same word at once: Shepherd. The Aurora Order will take the blame
scenes.text_anchor: two military officials were squatting beside Bakerland's body

scenes.setting: The bodyguard reappears in the oriel window: clothes handled; she will collect the 900 pounds herself — and, contract-abiding to a fault, insists on protecting him the full three days, name withheld
scenes.text_anchor: “I promised to protect you for three days, not just once.”

scenes.setting: Night thoughts in the crimson moonlight: too many Seer-pathway coincidences — the notebook, the transmigration, Roselle's diary — feel less like arrangement than mutual attraction; is there some strange characteristic to him that even lets him resurrect?
scenes.text_anchor: My second case after arriving at Backlund allowed me to get the next three potions formulas.

scenes.setting: Seven a.m., the full-length mirror: 'Someone from MI9 came last night. No.' — and a bone-piercing chill warns Klein off examining the tainted eye while she watches
scenes.text_anchor: “Someone from MI9 came last night.”

scenes.setting: The morning Tussock Times: 'Intis Ambassador to Backlund murdered! The Aurora Order claims responsibility!' — the affair closes under drizzle, and now there are adulterers to catch
scenes.text_anchor: “Intis Ambassador to Backlund murdered! Terrorist organization, the Aurora Order, claims responsibility!”

scenes.setting: Breakfast at Count Hall's villa: father and brother Hibbert debate the Aurora Order's motive over the newspaper while Audrey hides her astonished delight — Mr. A delivered overnight
scenes.text_anchor: “They assassinated the Intis Ambassador, Bakerland.

scenes.setting: Hillston Borough: Xio and Fors stare at the headline, dreading the final 8000-pound handoff — until Mr. A's message spares them: deposit it in anonymous accounts, don't come
scenes.text_anchor: “… This was done by Mr. A, wasn't it?”

scenes.setting: A temple-wide basement before a chained, vertical-eyed hanged-man statue: Mr. A prays for chaos to welcome his Lord's return, then coughs up squirming blood-colored fragments — and licks them back in
scenes.text_anchor: In front of him was a three-meter statue of a man hanging upside down

scenes.setting: The Quelaag Club: Klein tails mistress Erica Taylor in, takes a street-facing lounge two doors down, and puzzles over how to hide an exaggerated camera flash
scenes.text_anchor: he and Erica Taylor's room was separated by two rooms

scenes.setting: Miss Bodyguard fuses into the camera lens — a Spectral Camera with a contained flash; when Doragu arrives, Klein tarot-cards Erica's door and folds himself into the linen cupboard
scenes.text_anchor: She lowered her body and leaned over, slowly fusing into the camera's lens!

scenes.setting: Inside the linen cupboard, reading the affair by aura colors: silk stockings, ignition — then the Spectral Camera's contained flash catches Doragu and Erica mid-tumble, and Klein rolls out with a silent bow toward the bed
scenes.text_anchor: “Erica, I brought you a present,”

scenes.setting: Back in his own lounge: Miss Bodyguard's hand emerges from the camera lens; invited to breakfast, she notes she can go without eating for two weeks and vanishes into the mirror
scenes.text_anchor: At that moment, a hand suddenly stretched out from the camera lens.

scenes.setting: Club cafeteria breakfast with surgeon Aaron Ceres: the assassination headline, Parliament's pollution bills (good news for Mary's council ambitions), and Aaron's streak of unlucky failed surgeries
scenes.text_anchor: “Good morning, Dr. Ceres.”

scenes.setting: 300 pounds handed to Miss Bodyguard, photos developing — and an evening plan to work more Beyonder circles at the Bravehearts Bar while her protection lasts
scenes.text_anchor: went to withdraw 500 pounds in cash, and gave 300 pounds to Miss Bodyguard

scenes.setting: Before heading out: the invisible bodyguard confirms no one is monitoring — MI9 has dropped the cat-finding detective from its suspect list entirely
scenes.text_anchor: “Is someone monitoring me today?”

scenes.setting: Bravehearts Bar: a pound to Kaspars buys entry to tonight's gathering — half an hour of Southville beer and boxing while word is sent ahead
scenes.text_anchor: Kaspars was playing Texas poker with unlimited stakes.

scenes.setting: The iron-mask gathering again: Black Snake has died to the sewer beasts — Klein advises abandoning the herbs and tipping off the police, earning Eye of Wisdom's applause; afterwards the Apothecary of the Life School of Thought laments choosing virility medicine over luck
scenes.text_anchor: “Black Snake has apparently died in the sewers…

scenes.setting: After-hours with the last two: the Apothecary knows where in Backlund the Apothecary formula can be had and will sell spirituality-laced sedatives; Eye of Wisdom shares the Ernst-Firm newspaper code for future gatherings, shows off unsellable Sealed Artifact 2-081, and pitches a Sun-domain brooch and a water-shaping hat at 1500–3500 pounds
scenes.text_anchor: “My 2-081 was obtained from the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom.

scenes.setting: Rental carriage through the drizzle: Miss Bodyguard warns that Eye of Wisdom sensed her — then smells rich blood; a disemboweled woman lies at an alley mouth, and she names the culprits before vanishing: the Blood Sanctify Sect
scenes.text_anchor: “That Eye of Wisdom sensed my presence.”

scenes.setting: Saturday errands: word to Stelyn for Mary, the photos picked up, ten pounds of bail reclaimed (with an awkward glimpse of the real Sergeant Faxine), and the bodyguard's final 600 pounds paid in full
scenes.text_anchor: he also saw the real Sergeant Faxine and felt a little uncomfortable

scenes.setting: A new client over hot water: old Millet Carter of Midseashire found a secret door in his Williams Street basement opening onto a vast underground structure — 50 pounds to explore it quietly; coin and bodyguard's intuition both say take it
scenes.text_anchor: “Millet Carter,” the old gentleman answered simply.

scenes.setting: Contract signed, ten pounds advanced, four o'clock appointment set — and a cold steak wolfed down after the client finally leaves
scenes.text_anchor: After signing a contract with Millet Carter and receiving an advance payment of ten pounds

scenes.setting: Two o'clock: red-eyed Mary confirms the photo, pays the last seven pounds, and storms out with Stelyn struggling to keep up
scenes.text_anchor: “You're the most efficient and responsible detective I've ever met.

scenes.setting: A nap, then the map: Williams Street sits at the border of West and Empress Boroughs — a former viscount's property worth thousands
scenes.text_anchor: Williams Street was at the border of the West Borough and Empress Borough

scenes.setting: Unit 8 Williams Street, mid-renovation: Millet leads the 'assistant-less' detective to the basement's exposed gray stone door; lantern in hand, Klein enters a stone passageway of rotting ostentatious doors
scenes.text_anchor: “There's a secret door over there. It was discovered by the workers when they were renovating.”

scenes.setting: Beyond the black bifold door: a ten-meter nest of writhing snakes — snake-phobic Klein pleads for help and Miss Bodyguard's arctic wind scatters and frosts them; the upside-down candlesticks suggest a Fourth Epoch structure
scenes.text_anchor: It was a snake with a triangular head and red floral patterns on its head!

scenes.setting: Deeper into the Fourth Epoch hall: 81 inverted candlesticks, twin giant thrones bearing the Tudor scepter emblem and an unknown black crown ('Only an Emperor can be called an Emperor'), then seven asymmetric doors — the leftmost, marked with the Dark Sacred Emblem, hides a reclining gem-starred statue that looks like the Evernight Goddess herself
scenes.text_anchor: “This is the Tudor family's emblem.”

scenes.setting: Door by door: humanoid statues of Mother Earth, the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, the God of Combat and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom — six orthodox gods housed together under one Fourth Epoch roof; the central door remains, which Miss Bodyguard reads as 'very dangerous, but the danger is subdued — don't touch anything'
scenes.text_anchor: “The Sacred Emblem of Mother Earth…”

scenes.setting: The central passage: collapse both ways except a cracked door onto bone piles glowing with Beyonder characteristics before a blood-wet bifold door — then Azik's whistle turns death-cold, black worms erupt from Klein's arm, a devouring shadow chases them out. Miss Bodyguard's verdict: an evil spirit
scenes.text_anchor: What surged out from his wound wasn't blood, but tiny black squirming worms!

scenes.setting: Retreat through the ancient hall: no exorcism heroics — 'my life and health are more important' — a plan of research, maybe explosives, maybe an anonymous letter; Miss Bodyguard concedes he has some sense
scenes.text_anchor: “Are you not considering to get people to exorcise this evil spirit?

scenes.setting: Back in the basement: a cover story of venomous snakes keeps Millet's workers out; the house belonged to Viscount Pound — ennobled in the Battle of the Violated Oath, mysteriously declined, heirs lost — and the current bankrupt Baronet Pound is somewhere in Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: “Viscount Pound.”

scenes.setting: An invaded dream (visions only: a dark-gold dragon slain by a giant knight in blood-spattered black armor; the bloody bifold door cracking open on the same knight, decayed, seated on a black high-back chair): Klein jolts awake under the crimson moon
scenes.text_anchor: A dragon! A powerful dragon!

scenes.setting: Midnight mirror consult: the dream of the bloody door is only the evil spirit's lingering aura — it will fade; back to sleep
scenes.text_anchor: “I dreamed of the blood-stained door in that room.”

scenes.setting: Sunday papers over a soft-boiled egg: the Civil Servant Examination Bill passes (good news for Benson's head start), pollution councils approved, and no Ernst Firm ad — no gathering tomorrow
scenes.text_anchor: “The Civil Servant Unified Examination Bill has been officially passed

scenes.setting: Tingen, 2 Daffodil Street: Benson resolves to resign and sit the Backlund exams and urges Melissa toward the new Backlund technical university; when she leaves the table, his smile drops over Klein's silver pocket watch
scenes.text_anchor: “The Civil Servant Unified Examination Bill was passed?”

scenes.setting: Six fruitless library hours on the Pound family; at home the bodyguard announces 'the employment period is over' — but nods to hearing any Pound clues through Maric, curtsies, and is gone
scenes.text_anchor: “The employment period is over.”

scenes.setting: Late night, alone at last: a test grip on Rosago's All-Black Eye brings roars and the world laced in black threads
scenes.text_anchor: he took out the iron cigarette case and reached out to touch Rosago's All-Black Eye

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog the Eye falls silent: with Nimblewright threads Klein puppeteers a hooded fake member — 'Welcome, new member. Which tarot card do you wish to draw?' 'The World.'
scenes.text_anchor: “I choose the card ‘The World.'”
